notes.title: Update! Narrowing distances...
notes.content:
[b]Happy Holidays![/b] Perfect time to meet friends who are overseas.

This update of Little Inner Monsters will allow you to [u][b]create a private room and play with a friend from anywhere in the world[/b][/u].

In the previous versions, a private room connection was only possible between players located in the same region.

To do that, start online mode, name a private room, and create it, and a region prefix will be automatically added to the name.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41586848/a1d8099960f1cf13fd2432a3bb9ddb6df176990b.png[/img]

Tell your friend the room name, in the format xx-name, where xx is the region code.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41586848/7c4b356d3a5bad0b193c0630f2270a6f9c7d59a4.png[/img]

Your friend should inform this complete name when joining a room.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41586848/d6086cb58c92e928d6aeacf390517932a8fecdaa.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy it!
Follow our Steam developer’s page to keep track of our news!
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/menssana

notes.title: Let's play Dolmenjord - Vilking Islands!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937677/42c6d9a83597a15644ec5ec1dc89ad3c7411956e.png[/img]

Dolmenjord is a game inspired by Norse mythology, where Vikings need help to organize their buildings and villages and thus solve the puzzles and dominate new lands.

It is available now!

Great for Nordic culture fans who love to be challenged with logic puzzles.

Set up each village according to the rules:
- Place all the available houses and walkway pieces.
- Every house must face the walkway.
-  The completed walkway must give access to the port.

The puzzles are simple in the early islands, but it gets challenging as you advance in the exploration. If you prefer a more relaxing journey, that's fine!
Whenever you want, you can enable the Casual Mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937677/0577d939cf97d6c0faadc7f7a473c1082d2151f5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937677/0ce7c6cd9022add3519c6fd9c6425d9d2acb7393.jpg[/img]

Hi, folks!

[u][b]Island Cities[/b][/u] is the game we are releasing next. 🏣🏬

Cities are usually concrete jungles, noisy and stressful.
But you can also entertain yourself by looking at how they are organized, finding interesting details, and seeing life unfold. Then you can see that they are also vibrant and full of life.

Carefully observe the island, try to memorize it, then shuffle the blocks. Swap blocks to reproduce the desired island and the city will emerge.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/2878dba47a92b99123028c9889b15f681eca17b0.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update - Thanks for your feedback!
notes.content:
We got amazing feedback from you!

This update implements some UI improvements: more informative/friendly messages in the Multiplayer Options screen, Multiplayer Lobby and Memory Game.

Also fixes a bug that prevented Sana from picking her card under certain conditions, freezing the match.
And some minor visual bugs.

I hope you continue to enjoy the game.

We are a small studio, there are still few people playing the game.
If you liked it, share it! Tell your friends about it and invite them to online matches!
The more people playing, the more fun it will be!

We intend to keep improving the game, so please keep posting your comments on the Community Forum.

We are also on [url=https://twitter.com/MensSanaGames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/menssanainteractive/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://facebook.com/menssanainteractive/]Facebook[/url]!

notes.title: Happy 2022! See our next games
notes.content:
[b]Happy 2022 to our friends![/b] We wish you a year full of moments of joy and peace!

We're excited to tell you about some of our releases for the year.

[h1]Little Inner Monsters[/h1]
[b]Little Inner Monsters[/b] is the closest to release. It's a card game about emotions and feelings that you can play against a friend or against the computer.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/76273931635d8b0811b5350480359b42c425550c.png[/img]

The Steam page is active and you can add it to a wish list and follow it for updates.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1813190/Little_Inner_Monsters__Card_Game/?utm_source=steamnews&utm_campaign=ms_page


[h1]Christine[/h1]
[b]Christine[/b] is an interactive story about a young orphan working at the Paris Opera, with an untapped talent for singing. This game will take longer to be released, but we're working hard on it and hope you like it.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/034b846e870289df118b9d991d0c7363004f4dc4.png[/img]

The Steam page is also live!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1691500/Christine/?utm_source=steamnews&utm_campaign=ms_page

Both projects are being carried out in partnership with our friends Katia Numakura, producing the illustrations, and Tatyana Jacques, creating the music and sound design.
In addition to working with us on many games, they also have other amazing creations. Follow them on Instagram: 
[url=https://instagram.com/katia.numakura]@katia.numakura[/url]
[url=https://instagram.com/taty_jacques]@taty_jacques[/url]
